question: What is the SI unit of quantity of heat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Joule**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Heat

 
 
• Heat is the form of energy that produces in us the sensation of warmth.
 
• **Its SI unit is Joule.**
 
• It is a scalar quantity.
 
• Heat flows from a higher temperature body to a lower temperature body.
